question: Which genomic features are associated with extreme lifespan variation across Pacific Ocean rockfishes (genus Sebastes)?
known_answer_summary: DNA-repair pathway genes and copy-number expansion of butyrophilin/immune genes (Kolora et al., Science 2021).
note: Almost certainly in any frontier model's training data - a closed-book hit here proves contamination, not discovery.

question: What extracellular-matrix mechanism has been proposed for cancer resistance in the naked mole-rat?
known_answer_summary: Very-high-molecular-mass hyaluronan (Tian et al., Nature 2013); note the Hadi et al. 2020 dispute on cell-intrinsic resistance.

question: Which DNA-repair genes show bowhead-whale-specific changes proposed to relate to its longevity?
known_answer_summary: ERCC1 and PCNA changes (Keane et al., Cell Reports 2015); later CIRBP-related double-strand-break repair fidelity (Firsanov et al.).
note: Positive control only. Pre-2015 corpus has ~5 bowhead aging abstracts and none name ERCC1.

question: Which gene families differ between the immortal jellyfish Turritopsis dohrnii and its mortal relative?
known_answer_summary: Variants/expansions in DNA repair, telomere maintenance and stem-cell related genes (Pascual-Torner et al., PNAS 2022).
